MAT_T5_TERRAIN.source: blend of 15 Poly Haven 2K scans + procedural ice/canopy
MAT_T5_TERRAIN.maps: per layer: Base Color, Roughness, Normal GL, Displacement (height blend)
MAT_T5_TERRAIN.resolution: 2K per layer; near/far scale switch 150–900 m
MAT_T5_TERRAIN.drivers: mask attributes from NG_T5_HEIGHTFIELD + geometry slope + altitude + camera distance

MAT_T5_TERRAIN_DESERT.source: Poly Haven 2K: dry_ground_01, gravel_ground_01, sand_01, coast_sand_01, mud_cracked_dry_03, rocky_gravel, rock_ground, cliff_side (biplanar strata) + procedural far sand / far cliff / ripples
MAT_T5_TERRAIN_DESERT.maps: Base Color, Roughness, Normal GL, Displacement (height blend)

MAT_T5_TERRAIN_FORBIDDEN.source: Poly Haven 2K dry_ground_01, rocky_gravel, mud_cracked_dry_03, gravel_ground_01, dark_rock (darkened / desaturated) + procedural far
MAT_T5_TERRAIN_FORBIDDEN.maps: Base Color, Roughness, Normal GL, Displacement

MAT_T5_TERRAIN_ENCHANTED.source: Poly Haven 2K forest_floor, leafy_grass (re-coloured to moss / teal), mud_forest, river_small_rocks, mossy_rock + procedural far
MAT_T5_TERRAIN_ENCHANTED.maps: Base Color, Roughness, Normal GL, Displacement

MAT_T5_WATER_DARK.maps: opaque black water, roughness 0.32, small ripple bump
